WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    m.department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) as member_count
  FROM income i
  JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id
  JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.department
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.department,
    s1.member_count,
    CAST(s1.member_count AS REAL) / s2.total_members as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.department,
    s3.member_count,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_count) as sum_member_count,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step5
